title: Completion of Pair Extraction
statement: Let $first,second$ be Boolean flags, let $x,a,pre,rest$ be Boolean words, and suppose $x=pre\mathbin{++}rest$. Starting from the extractor configuration in state $0$, at input position $|pre|$, with tape word $a$, tape head at $|a|-1$ (truncated at zero), and empty output, there is a time $t\le 2|a|+|rest|+3$ at which the machine is halted and its output is $(a\text{ if }first\text{, otherwise }[])\mathbin{++}(rest\text{ if }second\text{, otherwise }[])$.
hypotheses_covered: first and second are Boolean flags
x, pre, rest, and a are Boolean words
